project.description: Target Angular project name. Defaults to the workspace default project.

styles.description: How to wire ngwr styles. `theme` appends `@use 'ngwr/theme';` to the project's global stylesheet — the token layer, which is the line that can carry `with ($base-colors: ...)`. `none` skips. Component styles are opt-in either way, via `ng g ngwr:component-style <name>`: there is no umbrella entry point.

x-prompt.message: How should ngwr styles be wired?

density.description: Default density wired via `provideWr(withDensity())`. `none` uses lib defaults (md).

skipPeerInstall.description: Skip running the package manager install task — useful in monorepos where you manage installs yourself.
